title: Enterprise Endpoint Security Architecture: EPP, EDR & XDR

modules.title: 1. What is Endpoint Security & Why It Exists
modules.content:
### What is Endpoint Security?

Endpoint security is the process of protecting network endpoints — desktops, laptops, mobile devices, servers, and IoT devices — from malicious threats and cyberattacks. It combines preventative protection (**EPP**) with continuous detection and response capabilities (**EDR**).

According to IBM's Cost of a Data Breach Report 2023, the average data breach cost reached **$4.45 million** — a 15% increase over three years.

#### Why Endpoint Security Exists:
- **Expanding Attack Surface**: Remote work and cloud adoption mean devices are no longer perimeter-protected by traditional firewalls.
- **Sophisticated Threats**: Fileless malware, zero-days, and ransomware bypass legacy antivirus.
- **Zero-Trust Architecture**: Every device must be continuously verified; trust is never assumed.
- **Compliance Mandates**: GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS mandate endpoint audit trails and encryption.

modules.title: 2. Subdomains: EPP vs EDR vs XDR
modules.content:
### The Endpoint Security Family

| Capability | Primary Goal | Detection Method | Response Action | Leading Vendors |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **EPP (Prevention)** | Block malware before execution | AV signatures + ML heuristics | Block file, quarantine | Microsoft Defender, Sophos |
| **EDR (Detection)** | Continuous telemetry & investigation | Behavioral analysis, process trees | Isolate host, kill process | CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne |
| **XDR (Extended)** | Cross-layer attack correlation | Endpoint + Network + Cloud + Email | Automated cross-domain containment | Palo Alto Cortex XDR, M365 Defender |

#### Core Capabilities Matrix:
- **Antivirus / NGAV**: Real-time file scanning & signature updates.
- **Behavioral Analysis**: Machine learning models detecting fileless malware.
- **Application & Device Control**: Whitelisting approved apps and blocking unauthorized USB drives.
- **Automated Isolation**: Immediately cutting network access to infected hosts in <5 seconds.

modules.title: 3. Internal Architecture & Agent Mechanics
modules.content:
### Three-Tier Enterprise Architecture

```text
Agent on Endpoint (Kernel Driver) ──> Local Engine (Behavioral Decision) ──> Cloud Management Console (Threat Intel Enrichment)
```

1. **Endpoint Agent**: Operates at the OS kernel level to intercept system calls, process creation, registry changes, and network sockets.
2. **Local Engine**: Analyzes activity in real-time. If offline, local rules continue to protect the endpoint using cached heuristics.
3. **Cloud Console**: Aggregates telemetry across millions of endpoints, enriches detections with global threat intelligence, and feeds SIEM/SOAR platforms.

modules.title: 4. Enterprise Tooling Comparison & Deployment
modules.content:
### Platform Comparison & GPO/Intune Deployment

| Platform | Category | Core Strengths | Best Fit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Microsoft Defender for Endpoint** | EPP + EDR | Native Windows integration, M365 ecosystem | Microsoft 365 & Azure AD enterprises |
| **CrowdStrike Falcon** | EPP + EDR | Ultra-lightweight agent (<1% CPU), top threat intel | Enterprises wanting best-in-class EDR |
| **SentinelOne Singularity** | EPP + EDR | Autonomous AI response & 1-click file rollback | Mid-market & autonomous SOC |
| **Cortex XDR** | XDR | Cross-layer network & endpoint correlation | Palo Alto Networks ecosystem |

#### GPO / PowerShell Onboarding Script:
```powershell
# Onboard Defender for Endpoint
Expand-Archive -Path 'C:\Deploy\DefenderATP.zip' -DestinationPath 'C:\Deploy\ATP'
cd C:\Deploy\ATP
.\WindowsDefenderATP-Onboarding.ps1
Get-Service -Name 'Sense' | Select-Object Status
```
